units.source_text: “这么说，你就是这样与镜子作斗争的吗？

en.t: So is this how you fight against the mirror?

units.source_text: 甚至在镜子里搜寻到我的科学。

en.t: You have even searched for my science inside the mirror.

units.source_text: 因为当今连涂脂抹粉，也叫化妆科学呀！”

en.t: Because nowadays even powdering and painting one's face is called cosmetic science!
